faq.headline: Frequent questions.
faq.q1: Do I need to hold crypto to accept it?
faq.a1: Nope. Buyers pay in any of our 15 supported coins & tokens across 9 chains, and you decide what you keep — hold the original coin, or auto-convert to USDC or USDT, settled to your wallet as soon as the payment confirms on-chain. You never touch a crypto exchange.
faq.a2: Directly in a wallet address you control — not held by us. Dynopay is non-custodial. Every settlement is a real on-chain transfer to your address.
faq.a3: Every payment costs a simple percentage — from 1.5% (Starter) down to 0.5% (Enterprise), based on your all-time settled volume — and your first payment is fee-free. No monthly fee, no setup fee, no chargebacks. See the Fees page for full pricing details.
faq.a4: It depends on the network. Stablecoin rails and fast chains (TRC-20, Polygon, L2s) usually confirm in a minute or two; Bitcoin and Ethereum mainnet can take longer when they're busy. Your dashboard shows live transaction status the whole way — and if you've turned on auto-convert, funds land in your chosen stablecoin the moment the payment confirms; otherwise you keep the coin the buyer sent.
faq.q5: Do you support fiat, refunds, or subscriptions?
faq.a5: Refunds, yes — one-click, on-chain reversals that send funds straight back to the buyer's address. We don't do fiat cards or auto-recurring subscriptions today: every charge is a direct, one-time crypto payment settled to a wallet you control, with optional auto-convert to USDC or USDT. Need a repeat payment? Just reshare the same link.
faq.a6: Yes. Share your referral link and you'll earn 25% of the Dynopay fees from every merchant you refer, for 12 months — taken as fee credit or cashed out in USDT (TRC-20). Your friend gets 50% off fees for 30 days the moment they join; your revenue share starts once they take their first payment.

pain.headline: Crypto payments shouldn't be this hard
pain.body: Volatile balances, custodial risk, chargeback fraud and bolted-on checkouts hold merchants back. Dynopay removes each one.
pain.p1: Prices swing before you can spend what you earned.
pain.f1: Auto-convert every payment to stablecoin the moment it settles.
pain.p2: A third party holds your funds — and can freeze them.
pain.f2: Non-custodial by design: crypto lands in your own wallet, never ours.
pain.p3: Card chargebacks claw back revenue months later.
pain.f3: On-chain payments are final — zero chargebacks, ever.
pain.p4: Integrations drag on and the checkout feels bolted-on.
pain.f4: A hosted checkout and clean REST API get you live in an afternoon.

security.headline: The controls are already shipped.
security.body: Everything below is live in every account today — not a roadmap.

nonCustodial.d: Funds settle straight to wallet addresses you add. We never hold your balance.

convert.d: Turn it on and each payment lands as USDC or USDT the moment it confirms.

refunds.d: Refund the full or a partial amount in the original coin from your dashboard; the buyer gets a receipt.

twofa.d: Authenticator codes plus one-time backup codes, with a step-up at login.

walletLock.d: Address changes need an email code; every change is logged and can be reverted from the alert email.

sessions.d: See every signed-in device, sign out everywhere in one tap and get alerted on new-device logins.

webhooks.d: HMAC-signed events with automatic retries and a dead-letter queue.

kyc.d: Identity checks kick in as your volume grows; GDPR-compliant data handling.

status.d: Live uptime for payments, rates, webhooks and API, with 90-day history.

dev.headline: One request. A real response.
dev.body: A plain REST API you can call from anything. Create a payment, redirect the buyer, listen for the webhook.
dev.b1: Signed webhooks for every payment event
dev.b2: Sandbox keys to test without moving funds
dev.worksWith: Works with any language or framework that can make an HTTP request — plus a copy-paste buy button for static sites.
dev.snippetNote: Sandbox key shown. Live keys are created in your dashboard under Developers; the response shape is identical in production.

coins.headline: {{coins}} coins and tokens, 9 chains.
coins.body: Every asset your buyers can pay with — the same list our checkout uses. Stablecoins on the cheapest rails included.

cost.a: 1.5% per payment to start, dropping to 1.0%, 0.7% and 0.5% as your lifetime settled volume grows. Your first payment is platform-fee-free. No monthly fee, no setup fee, no chargebacks. Network fees go to the blockchain, and you choose whether you or the buyer covers them.

funds.a: Directly to a wallet address you control. Dynopay is non-custodial — we never hold your balance, and every settlement is a real on-chain transfer.

speed.q: How fast do I get paid?
speed.a: As fast as the network confirms. Solana and XRP take seconds; USDT on Tron and Polygon under a minute; Ethereum a few minutes; Bitcoin 10–60 minutes. You see the status live and get a webhook and email when it settles.

crypto.q: Do I need to understand crypto?
crypto.a: No. You set a price in your currency, the buyer picks a coin, and we show them the exact amount. Turn on auto-convert and you receive USDC or USDT without ever touching an exchange.

wallet.a: Any wallet you control — a hardware or mobile wallet, or an exchange deposit address. Add one payout address per coin you accept; our wallet guide walks you through it.

buyers.a: A wallet holding one of the supported coins. They scan the QR or copy the address and amount — no account, no sign-up. The checkout is available in six languages.

donations.q: Can I raise funds or take tips?
donations.a: Yes. Launch a crowdfunding campaign with a goal bar and reward tiers, or a simple tip jar — supporters pay in crypto from anywhere, no account needed, and funds settle straight to a wallet you control.

refunds.a: Yes. Refund the full or a partial amount in the original coin from your dashboard. The buyer receives an emailed receipt for the refund.

wrongAmount.q: What if a buyer sends the wrong amount?
wrongAmount.a: Payments are matched to the exact amount shown at checkout. Small underpayments within the tolerance you set are accepted automatically; larger shortfalls are flagged in your dashboard so you can refund or resolve them with the buyer. Overpayments settle in full.

legal.a: Accepting crypto is legal in most countries, and you remain responsible for local rules and taxes. Dynopay applies KYC/AML checks as your volume grows and handles data under GDPR.

myCountry.q: Can I use Dynopay from my country?
myCountry.a: Almost certainly, yes. There's no country list to apply to and no bank or card network that has to approve you — if you can hold a crypto wallet, you can accept payments and settle straight to it. You sign up with an email, add a payout wallet and can start the same day. The only exception is the handful of jurisdictions under international sanctions.

countries.a: Merchants and buyers work from virtually anywhere in the world — payments settle on-chain, so there's no country list to check against. We onboard new merchants across dozens of countries every month, and only jurisdictions under international sanctions are excluded. Checkout is available in English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Dutch.

referral.a: Yes. Share your referral link and earn 25% of the Dynopay fees from every merchant you refer for 12 months, as fee credit or paid out in USDT. Your referral gets 50% off fees for their first 30 days.

final.body: Create a free account, add a payout wallet and share your first link. Your first payment is fee-free.

live.sub: Live payments across the network — coin, chain and time only. No names, no amounts.

onchain.body: A few recent payments to our own Dynopay store. Each one is a real transaction — open it on a block explorer and confirm the money moved.

wallets.title: Pay from any wallet
wallets.sub: Buyers scan and send from whatever they already use — no account with us required.

global.headline: Payments from {{countries}}+ countries.
global.body: There's no country list to apply to and no bank sign-off to wait for. If your customers can hold a crypto wallet, they can pay you from anywhere in the world — and every payment settles straight to a wallet you control.
